crossRefs.note: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.
“Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service…

translations.web: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.
translations.bsb: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.
translations.kjv: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
translations.asv: They make oil within the walls of these men; They tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
